newsitem.title: DUBAI: UAE and Total agree to set up paint plant.
newsitem.headline: UAE and Total agree to set up paint plant.

text.p: A local firm and a subsidiary of French oil giant Total signed an agreement on Sunday to set up a $2.5 million factory to produce paint for oil pipelines, the United Arab Emirates (UAE) news agency WAM said.
Al-Hamed group will hold 85 percent of shares in the Abu Dhabi-based firm, due to start production later this year, while their French partner will own the rest.
The plant will produce 3,000 tonnes of paint a year needed to protect oil pipelines and output would be increased according to demand, the news agency said.
The product will be marketed locally and across the region, where annual demand for oil pipeline paint is estimated by industry sources at 20,000 tonnes.
Abu Dhabi accounts for over 90 percent of UAE oil output of more than 2.16 million barrels per day (bpd).
